# Accepted dependency advisories for the pip-audit gate in .github/workflows/ci.yml
#
# Format: one advisory ID per line. Everything after `#` is a comment.
#
# RULES:
#   1. Every entry needs a reason and a review date. No bare IDs.
#   2. An entry is a decision to SHIP a known vulnerability. It is not a way to
#      make CI green - if you cannot write a defensible reason, fix the dependency.
#   3. Re-check every entry at its review date. Suppressions rot: a CVE with no
#      fix today usually has one in three months.
#
# To suppress nothing, leave this file with comments only - that is the goal state.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CURRENT STATUS: EMPTY - the goal state. Nothing is suppressed.
#
# History: 9 of the original 10 advisories were FIXED by upgrading fastapi
# 0.115.14 -> 0.136.3 and starlette 0.46.2 -> 1.6.0 (and python-multipart
# 0.0.20 -> 0.0.32). The last two - PYSEC-2026-1325 (ecdsa, Minerva; decided
# 2026-08-27 on PR #18) and CVE-2026-85394 (python-jose HS256 forgery; decided
# 2026-10-10, suppressed in PR #120) - were both cleared on 2026-10-12 by
# migrating python-jose -> PyJWT, which removed python-jose, ecdsa, rsa and
# pyasn1 from the dependency tree. See
# docs/sop/2026-10-12-python-jose-to-pyjwt-migration.md.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
